tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ dgongs gter rdo rje'i gsung gi don bkrol ba// lha mo'i gsang mdos zhes kyang bya// ri rab brtsegs mdos zhes kyang bya// ma mo'i khrag mdos zhes kyang bya// ma mo'i nad rims bzlog mdos zhes kyang bya ste tshig nyung khyer bde ba yod//

na mo de wi kā li ye// lha mo dpon g.yog zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ri rab brtsegs mdos ma mo'i khrag mdos dang*// rims nad bzlog pa'i mdos chog gsal bkod bya// lha mo 'khor bcas bka' yi gnang ba stsol// 'di la rgyas 'bring bsdus pa shin tu bsdus// bca' tshul khyad yin 'don cha'i gzhung ni gcig /mdos gdan shing ngam gang yang rung ba'i steng*// ri rab bang rim bzhi pa phyogs mdog steng*// zan nam sa la lha mo'i gzugs nag mo// gri thod 'dzin nam yang na thal brdeb tshul// ri rab rtse ru byams 'dug byas pa bya// gru khug g.yas su byang dmar yi ge can// gnod byed dgra bgegs zhes bya'i ming can btsugs// g.yas su mda' bkra g.yon du 'phang bkra dang*// rgyab tu nam mkha' khra bo shing ris btsugs// mchan zhabs g.yon du nad kyi rkyal pa'i gzugs// pang du tshon skud sna lnga'i gru gu bzhag /bang rim gnyis par bskang spar btab bya ste// dbus mdun rkang pa'i bar du 'khor lo dang*// shar du rdo rje lho ru rin po che// nub tu pad+ma byang du ral gri dang*// bya nag bcu gsum gtso byas 'dab chags tshogs// bang rim gsum par lug nag bcu gsum gyi// gtsor byas bskang 'bras thams cad cha tshang btsugs// bang rim bzhi par rtsang ni drug cu bzhi// srin mo 'gros btsugs ri rab rtsa ba ru// g.yas su zan la bya mo nag mo'i gzugs// mgrin par dung phreng ze ba mchu ni dmar// g.yon du lug nag spyi bo dkar po can// mdun du zan nang tshwa bstum sgo nga'i gzugs// rgyab tu sman ting brtsegs ma rtse mo dkar// bar mtshams mtheb kyu sha dum 'khor bar bskor// snod gzhan nang du ngar mi gcig gi mdun// mar me gsum bzhag tha ma dri glud bskor// mdos chen cung zhig btegs nas mtho bar bzhag /de yi g.yas g.yon gang bder ngar mi dang*// mdun der zangs lcags snod ni gtsang ma bzhag /de mdun yod na lug nag lpags pa gting*// de dbus tshon nam 'bru nag la sogs kyis// chos 'byung zur drug bris pa'i dbus dang zur// phor pa gtsang ma chag gas med pa bdun// kha dang mthil ni mar gyis brgyan par bya// gzhi yi g.yas g.yon 'jim pa'i gzugs brnyan gnyis// lha gzugs dkar po dgye zhing dar dkar phyar// de drung shwa dkar mig dgu bris pa dang*// rde'u dkar po bcu gsum bzhag par bya// g.yon du 'dre gzugs nag po mgo bkug pa// lag tu dar nag dril nas thur du bzung*// de drung shwa nag lnga bris rdel nag dgu// bar du 'brang rgyas phyed dkar phyed nag gcig

/de steng bal tshon sna lnga 'dab gcig bkab// khrag dang chu bsres bya bo gang dang ni// de bzhin chang phud gser skyems bdar ba dang*// gtor chung zur gsum snying 'dra drug cu lnga// sha dum theb kyu ling chung de yi grangs// de ni bca' tshogs rgyas pa khrag mdos lugs/ ༈ /'bring ba gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba las// rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bya nag lug nag las// bskang 'bras gzhan rnams btsugs ni mi dgos so// rtsang yang nyi shu rtsa brgyad btsugs pas 'thus// gzhi nag phor pa bdun dang lha bdud gzugs// 'brang rgyas bal tshon sogs kyang mi dgos so/ ༈ /bsdus pa ka ṭo ra'am sder chen nang*// 'jim pa gru bzhi rtsa ba phra bar bya// rtse la zan nag lha mo'i gzugs de bzhag /mda' 'phang khram shing nam mkha' la sogs kyang*// cung zad brda mtshon khyud re tsam gyis chog /rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bya nag bdun dang ni// lug nag bdun ni btsugs pas bskang 'bras tshang*// bya mo lug nag sman ting sgo nga bca'/ ༈ /shin tu bsdus pa rgyun khyer la sogs par// dmar gtor gcig la bya mo lug nag dang*// sman ting sgo nga bzhis bskor sder nang bzhag /rtse ru tsakli gcig ni btsugs pa'i nang*// lha mo ri rab rtse ru byams bzhugs byas// byang dmar khram shing nad rkyal tshon gru can// rgyab tu nam mkha' shing ris mda' 'phang bris// de ltar bca' tshul rgyas 'bring bsdus pa dang*// shin tu bsdus pa gang 'dod rung ba ltar// gtor chung rak+ta la sogs 'bul ba'i grangs// rab ni brgya'am yang na drug cu lnga// 'bring du lo grangs sam ni nyi shu gcig /tha ma bcu gsum mam ni dgu yis 'thus// yi dam gshin rje'i gshed dam phyag rdor bsgom// yang na yi dam gang yang rung ba yin// de nas snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas gyer sgom sbrag /glu dang dbyangs la lha mo dgyes pa yin// rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros pas mdos kyi mi gtsang ba'i dri ma thams cad bsreg

/oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ las/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ gser gyi ri bdun/ bya nag lug nag bya mo nag mo/ bshos bu sman gtor rak+ta phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin/ mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas brten rdzas so so'i yid dang mthun pa'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ rang gi mdun du ri bdun rol mtsho dang bcas pa'i ri rab kyi khar dpal ldan lha mo sku mdog shin tu gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin nas 'dug pa/ 'khor snang srid kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro nad bdag rims bdag thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par gyur/ bh+yo/ mu le mtsho dang yongs 'du'i shing*// dur khrod brgyad sogs bzhugs gnas nas// lha mo 'khor bcas spyan 'dren no// sdang dgra'i steng du dgyes par bzhugs// bh+yoḥm hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yoḥhrī dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa yi// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// bshos bu gzugs sgra dri ro dang*// reg bya sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs// lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// 'khor bcas mnyes shing tshim gyur cig /bh+yoḥm hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo/ a mṛ ta ba liṃ ta rak+ta khā hi khā hi// ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ bh+yo/ chos sku skye med ngang nyid las// 'gro ba'i don du sku sprul nas// 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i tshul// ma dang sring ltar sgrub la brtse// lha mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod// dam rdzas mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// thugs dang 'gal ba mthol zhing bshags// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// yams nad rims nad zhi ba dang*// 'bru dang rkang 'gros 'phel rgyas mdzod// 'dod rgu thams cad dbang du sdus// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol// ma g.yel myur du las mdzod cig

/bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// lha mo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng*// bh+yo las sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor// de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros// snang srid ma mo thams cad dang*// nad bdag dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun// dbang du bsdus nas bran du bkol// bdag dang lha mo'i bka' nyan cing*// ci bcol las rnams sgrub par gyur/ bh+yo ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo// zhes pa'i sngags de ci 'grub brjod// 'di nyid gzhan la sbyin pa na// mngon rtogs nas bzung 'di yan brjod// gtor ma slob ma'i lag tu gtad// lha mo 'di la stsal lags kyi// bsrung zhing skyob par mdzad du gsol/ bh+yo ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo/ oṃ trag thim ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐// lan gsum brjod cing lag tu gtad// maṇ+ḍal phul bas bka' gtad thob// 'di nyid bca' 'don bya bar rung*// de nas khrag snod bran byas la/ phaṭa/ skad cig gis rak+ta'i snod kyi thad bar snang la/ zhing bcu ru tra'i ngo bo khrag gi grod pa gcig yer gyis byung*/ de la bdag gis phur pa tshad pa tsam gyis khrag gi rgyun babs/ khrag gi rgya mtsho rba klong rab tu 'khrugs pas ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad mnyes pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ sman dang gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥswā hā/ zhes grangs theb pas thod ting nang du gtor chung zur gsum snying 'dra ba'i rtser mar rgyan byug pa dang*/ mtheb kyu sha dum bran la/ mchog g.yog pa yod na bzung bcol/ bh+yo/ gzhong pa rnam dag zla gam dkyil 'khor du// tshe dang gal gyi mthun gnyis mthun sdeb ste// dkar gyis thig gdab dmar gyis gur phub pa// longs spyod rdzas kyi mchod pa chen po 'di// 'bul ni lha mo dpon g.yog rnams la 'bul// bskang ni ma mo yongs kyi thugs dam bskang*// nad bdag dregs pa'i tshogs rnams tshim gyur cig

/a la la ho 'di ni bzhes su gsol// a la la ho bzhes te dgyes par rol// bh+yo ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo/ sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ces mdos kyi nang ngam mdos mdun gyi zangs lcags snod du gtor ma blug /de nas mchod g.yog pas bum pa'am/ gtor 'gu'am/ skyog chung gis phor pa bdun po'i nang du rim par khrag chu phyar zhing*/ bh+yo/ rak+ta khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil pa la// snang srid thams cad rba rlabs kyi li li// mkha' dbyings ma mo mkha' 'gro mchod pa dang*// 'phags ma lha mo dpon g.yog thugs dam bskang*// nad bdag dregs pa'i tshogs rnams tshim gyur cig /a la la ho 'di ni bzhes su gsol// a la la ho bzhes te dgyes par rol/ bh+yo ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo// rak+ta pi pa to khā hi// mdos dang mdos mdun du gtor ma blug pa de dang khrag gi phor pa rnams nang mchod bdud rtsis bran pa'am thigs pa re blugs shing*/ bh+yo/ rin chen in+d+ra nī la'i bum par ni// 'bru bcud stong sbyar dza gad dpa' bos gtams// gnyis med byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin mchog /'thung bu 'tsho ba'i longs spyod chen po 'di// 'bul ni ye shes ma mo rnams la 'bul// bskang ni ma mo yongs kyi thugs dam bskang*// nad bdag dregs pa'i tshogs rnams tshim gyur cig /a la la ho 'di ni bzhes su gsol// a la la ho bzhes te dgyes par rol/ bh+yo ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo// dza gad kha ram̐ khā hi/ bh+yo/ lha mo nag mo gtsor byas pa'i// ma mo'i rigs gyur ma lus rnams// khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// 'dod yon sna tshogs mchod pa 'bul// khyed kyi thugs dam bskang gyur cig /thugs dam 'gal ba mthol lo bshags// nad rims yams nad mi mthun phyogs// thams cad ma mos bzlog tu gsol// 'brum bu 'dzum dang sbar ba rta// hur thum nad rims zhi bar mdzod// rgyu gzer 'bras gzer gdug pa can// mi mthun nad rnams bzlog tu gsol// mig ser gre 'byar gre thor sogs// mda' brgyab nad kun zhi bar mdzod// dkar khra ma rmos bdud kyi glang*// mgo bskor byed pa'i nad kun zlog

/gzer thung mid dkyus dbugs 'thum sogs// bsdongs ya'i nad kun zhi bar mdzod// gdug pa dmar bshal srin glang sogs// skad cig nad kun zhi bar mdzod// long nad 'thor ba nywa gas sogs// shin tu mi sdug nad kun zlog /mdor na rims kyi rigs gyur dang*// 'thor nad dus nad nad kun zlog /bh+yo de wi kā li ni mu khrad na na nas ni i kaṃ yi/ yu ta bha/ rak+sha bh+yo/ mo khra trad hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yo zlog /de ltar sman raka gtor gsum dang*// nad bzlog bcas pa gcig tu brtsi// rab ni brgya'am drug cu lnga// 'bring ni lo grangs sam nyer gcig /tha ma dgu'am bcu gsum dbul// bsdus dang shin tu bsdus pa la// gtor chung gis ni mdos gso zhing*// khrag thig blug cing bdud rtsis bran// de yan rgyas bsdus rim pa'o/ ༈ slar yang mtheb kyu gso bran bya// ma mo 'bum gyi rgyud lung las// sems can dus min 'chi ba de// bskang ba'i gnas lnga 'di rnams so/ hūm̐/ snang srid thams cad yum gyi bha ga ste// dus gsum bde gshegs yum gyi klong nas bskyed// dbus kyi che mchog sku dang gnyis med bzhugs// mu mthar khyab pa'i thugs dam bdag bskang na// dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi gtso// rdo rje dbyings phyug mi phyed ma// bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*// lho phyogs rin chen rigs kyi gtso// rin chen dbyings phyug mi phyed ma// bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*// nub phyogs pad+ma rigs kyi gtso// pad+ma dbyings phyug mi phyed ma// bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*// byang phyogs las kyi rigs kyi gtso// las kyi dbyings phyug mi phyed ma// bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*// dbyings kyi ma chen brgyad rnams kyang*// bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*// yum gyi ma mo brgyad rnams kyang*// bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*/

bh+yo/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// mkha' 'gro ma dang shugs 'gro ma// phra men ma dang rgya mtsho ma// gting 'gro ma dang ma mo rnams// dregs pa lha srin pho mo'i tshogs// ma lus gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// dur khrod chen po rtsub 'gyur tshal// dug rlangs sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i gzhal yas nas// thod mkhar 'bar ba'i mnga' bdag mo// gdug pa'i bu mo mi bzad ma// ma mo nag mo khro tshul can// re ti nag po srog gi shan pa mo// tsan ti ka te 'bar ba'i gdong pa can// rims dang yams kyi nad bdag mo// bskang ngo bskal pas thugs dam bskang*// shan pa pho mo ro langs tshogs// 'khor du gtogs pa khyed rnams la// mdos dang glud 'bul nyams chag bskang*// rin chen sna lnga'i tshogs bkram nas// tshogs dang gtor ma rak+ta dang*// sman dang bdud rtsi'i mchod pas kyang*// khyed kyi thugs dam gnyan po bskang*// srog chags nag mo bdun 'bum dang*// gcan gzan lce spyang tshogs rnams kyis// lha mo khyod kyis thugs dam bskang*// mdos dang glud longs rkyen dbang zlog /'khor srungs mdos dang zor kha chings// gdug pa'i dbal kha dgra la ston// mdos 'phyongs de nyid dug rlangs khol ma'i rgyud tshig go /bh+yo/ sngon tshe stong pa'i gling rum nas// sgo nga'i nang nas bya mo dang*// lha mo nag mo spun du 'khrungs// bya mo lha mo 'bral ba med// bya skad ru lus lha mo mnyes// ma 'ongs mnyam du rdzogs sangs rgyas// da lta lha mo bskang ba'i rdzas// 'bru sna las byas bya mo 'di// mdog nag dung gi phra yis brgyan// pad+ma rā ga'i ze ba mchu// dar nag brjid chen rin chen brgyan// rang 'dra'i 'bum phrag sprul pa 'gyed// spyan la mdzes shing thugs la gces// lha mo 'khor bcas bya 'di bzhes// thugs dam bskang la rkyen ngan zlog

/shel lug nag po spyi dkar 'di// sku lus mun pa gtibs pa 'dra// 'khyil pa'i rwa la chu ris bkra// gser gyi spyan mig 'od du 'bar// 'ba' skad lhang lhang lha mo dgyes// dar nag rgyan btags mar gyis byugs// ma mo rnams kyi mthun rdzas bzhes// thugs dam bskang la rkyen rnams zlog /de mo nag mo'i sgo nga 'di// yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel 'dra// dpal ldan lha mo dpon g.yog gi /ljags la gces shing khams la phan// ma yi mdun du bu sdug 'dra// ma mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskang la rkyen ngan zlog /bh+yo/ ma mo bdud mo'i tshogs rnams la// mthun rdzas rin chen sman leb 'bul// sman leb zlum po spros dang bral// sman leb brtsegs ma thabs shes tshul// dbus ma 'bur bas yon tan rgyas// rtse mo zur gsum sku gsung thugs// 'od 'bar nad zhi sdug bsngal sel// ma mo rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskang la rkyen ngan zlog /bh+yo/ ma cig lha mo rnal 'byor ma// thugs ni snang srid kun la gsal// phrin las rnal 'byor don la dgongs// sku mdog ma nges sna tshogs cir yang ston// ma la nam mkha' khra bo 'di phul bas// ma cig thugs dam dbyings nas bskang gyur cig /'phrul gyi mda' bkra sgro bsgron mdel gyis mthud// dar tshon lngas brgyan skyes pa pho yi glud// skyes pa dpa' rtsal ldan par byin brlab nas// gcig las brgya stong du ma'i sprul pa 'phro// ma mo rnams la dgyes sde'i grogs su 'bul// pho bdud dal kha thams cad g.yas su sgyur// 'phrul gyi 'phang bkra rin chen mo lus brgyan// tshon skud lnga dkris za ma mo yi glud// mo btsun mdzes mar byin gyis brlab pas na// gcig las sprul pa bye ba dung phyur 'phro// ma mo rnams la mthun rdzas bran du 'bul// mo bdud dal kha thams cad g.yon du sgyur/ bh+yo/ bdud mo nag mo re ma ti// phyag na bdud kyi khram bam bsnams// srog dbugs bsdus pa'i mi rnams las// sang phod dus su su 'chi ba// da lo khyod kyis khram la 'debs// dpyid kyi rol po kha nag dang*// dbyar gyi shing lo lhab lhub dang*// ston gyi sbang po kha ser dang*// dgun gyi 'khyag pa chal chol ste// mi yi bdud gcod dus bzhi la// bdag dang bsrung bya yon bdag 'di// gal te khram la btab srid na// mdos glud khram shing 'di bzhes la// bdud kyi khram kha da phyes shig

/ma cig khyod kyi mchan khung na// rtsis kyi byang bu dmar po 'dzin// sang phod da tshod su 'chi ba// da lo byang dmar ngos la bri// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di// rtsis su bcug na rtsis las phyungs// byang dmar ngos la bris pa khrus// zhing bcu bstan pa'i spyi dgra rnams// khram la thob la byang bur bris// mnyam gnyis brjes la mtshungs gnyis bzor// ma cig khyod kyi mchan khung na// tshon gyi gru gu khra gsum bsnams// gang la btab pa shor mi srid// bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la// tshon gru brkyang pa mi srid kyi// gal te tshon gru brkyang na yang*// mdos glud tshon gru 'di bzhes la// tshon gyi gru gu myur du sdus// byams pa'i thugs kyis dgongs par mdzod/ bh+yo/ mdos chen ri rab gling bzhi'i gzugs// rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan brgyan pa 'di// ye shes ma mo mnyes pa'i rdzas// bya nag mang pos gtsor byas pa'i// 'dab chags mang po'i gzugs brnyan bkod// las kyi ma mo mnyes pa'i rdzas// lug nag mang pos gtsor byas pa'i// skye 'gro sna tshogs gzugs bkod pa// 'jig rten ma mo mnyes pa'i rdzas// ri rab bang rim tha ma la// rtsang dmar srin mo'i 'gros su bkod// srin mo drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*// ma tshogs dbang phyug mnyes pa'i rdzas// mnyes pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*// chag che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol/ bh+yo/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// gsang sngags dar kyang dam tshig g.yel// phal cher nag mo'i phyogs la spyod// de tshe lha mo dpon g.yog 'khrug /'gal rkyen bar chad ci yang 'byung*// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// tha ma da lta yan chad du// rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i// mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga// log pa brgyad dang lci ba bzhi// gang bgyis thams cad mthol lo bshags// bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig la// nyes ltung nyams chag gang byung bshags// bong bu ma byams skyon btags brdungs// me dang ne'u ler ma bstod smad// zhing lpags rma bya'i mdongs ma 'chang*// 'tshub ma'i sked bcad rgyab brnyen smad// yug sar chags pa ma spyad sogs// rje mo'i thugs dang gang 'gal bshags// nal ma nal phrug ma byams sdang*// shing lo rlung khyer ma bzung dang*// rdo sol rnyed nas chu la bskyur// kha 'phro bsres dang phreng bar reg

/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha sam+bha ra hūm̐/ gsum mam bdun brjod/ sku gsung thugs la mar mai gsum// sku yi mar me 'od zer 'phro// gsung gi mar me chags dang ldan// thugs kyi mar me rgyan du che// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /lus ngag yid gsum glud du 'bul// lan chags mgron du gyur rnams kyi// ma rig mun pa sangs gyur cig /shwa gzhi'i steng du lha gzugs 'dre gzugs shwa dang rde'u rnams bran la/ bh+yo/ srid pa las la grub pa yi// lha thang lha mkhar dkar po'i rtser// lha gcig bzhugs pa lhan skyes lha// lha phran mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor// 'brang rgyas phyed dkar 'di bzhes la// lha yi kha 'dzin ma chung zhig /lha 'dre'i 'dun sa da shigs shig /'dre thang 'dre mkhar nag po'i rtser// 'dre zhig yod pa lhan skyes 'dre// 'dre phran mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor// 'brang rgyas phyed nag 'di bzhes la// 'dre yi gdug pa ma ston cig /lha 'dre'i 'dun sa da shigs shig /a tri pra we sha ya phaṭa/ 'brang rgyas bgos la dkar nag lha 'dre so so'i mdun du bzhag /shwa dkar nag bsgril bcug cing*/ bh+yo/ ma cig lha mo'i thugs sprul ni// dkar mo ral gcig bya ra mkhan// sku la dar dkar go zu gsol// dbu la dar dkar che zhu gsol// phyag na shwa rde'u dkar po brtsi// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// do nub lha shwa dkar po bkyes// drangs mkhan nam mkha'i dbyings nas bzhengs// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung mas drangs mkhan mdzod// dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// chos nyid rten 'brel bden stobs kyis// nag po'i phyogs rnams pham pa dang*// dkar phyogs lha rnams rgyal gyur cig /g.yu 'brug gangs seng rgod glag dang*// rgya stag bu chung khyi dod rnams// ral pa can gyi shwa dpon mdzod/ bh+yo/ bdud mo nag mo mi zan ma// sku ni mi la thugs ni bdud// mdog nag mun pa'i go zu gsol// phyag na shwa rdel nag po brtsi// khyod la ngar mi glud gtor 'bul// mnyam gnyis brjes la mtshungs gnyis bzor// shwa la bab na brje bar mdzod// rtsis la bab na rtsis las phyung*// oṃ de wa pañca puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/

rgyas nag po gnyis// 'dre lnga bdud gcod gnas phyogs sam// yang na lo bdud phyogs su bskyal// de nas khrag gi phor pa rnams// mdos mdun snod kyi nang du blugs// slar yang phor pa rang mal bzhag /khrag gam khrag chus bkang byas te// bdud rtsis bran te bzhag par bya// khrag lung khrag gi 'phyong 'di 'don/ bh+yo/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// dzam gling lho phyogs dur khrod na// lha chen ma hā de gnyis byung ba// ming po legs ldan thod phreng can// sring mo lha mo dung skyong ma// sha khrag rkan mar byin nas gsos// de phyir lha mo khrag la dgyes// dmar chen khrag gi dri tshor nas// mtshan mo gcig la dpag tshad yang*// brgyad khri bzhi stong khyab par rgyug /nu ma'i g.yab mo rdeb cing 'gro// dpal ldan lha mo khrag dga' ma// khrag dga' ma khyod khrag gis mchod// sngags 'chang dgos pa'i /yungs dkar la sogs thun btab// lug nag lpags pa'am phyar nag steng du phor pa sngar nas bzhag pa de/ bud med dam sngags pa bzhis zur bzhi nas btegs/ dgra phyogs sam gnod pa'i phyogs su kha bltas la/ bh+yo/ shar gyi dkar mo spyan gcig ma// bya rgod thul pa g.yu dril brgyan// dung gi lan tshar gser gyi thod// dkar mo 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas// lho na nag mo mche ba can// zhing gi go zu gser gyi dril// lcags kyi lan phran g.yu yi thod// nag mo 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas// nub kyi dmar mo dbang sdud ma// chu srin g.yang gzhi sbrul gdengs can// g.yu yi lan phran byi ru'i thod// dmar mo 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas// byang gi ser mo las mkhan ma// rma bya'i thul pa mthing gi dril// gser gyi lan phran thod lding can// ljang mo 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas// rgyal chen bzhi yi keg bsgyur ma// g.yas pas thod pa khrag bkang 'phen// g.yon pas thun rdzas bsngags shing 'debs// gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs// gang la brgyab pa brgyal zhing 'bog /gnas la phog na rgya gram 'jig /mi bzad zor bdag a la la// phyogs bzhi'i dmag dpung chi li li// ru mtshon mang po thibs se thib// mdung bzung mang po rongs se rong*// ba dan mang po lhubs se lhub// ma mo'i khrag zor khra la la// khrag gi rba rlabs chi li li// yungs dkar sngags mda' me bas rno// mtshe mo nyung nag mdung bas rno// gnod pa'i bgegs la dbab pa'i tshe// gnam lha dkar po khrag tu skyug /byi na ya ka 'dar zhing brgyal// gnod byed dgra bgegs phyogs su bh+yo/ zhes brjod phor pa'i nang gi khrag thigs dang*/ nyungs dkar thams cad phor pa gcig gi nang du blugs la/ lo bdud phyogs sam gnod pa'i phyogs su phyir dor bcug /zhal bu rnams chu gtsang gis bshal la mdos mdun gyi snod du blug /zhal bu rnams la nas cung zad btab chang phud blugs la/

sngar ltar btegs bcug la/ rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa dang*// lha mo dpon g.yog mthu stobs dang*// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// khrag phor zhal bu bdun po la// legs nyes pra rtags bstan du gsol// bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// na tsha shi chad mi 'ong na// zhal bu gcig tsam kha sbub la// drug po gnam du kha zed cig /cung zad rtsub cha yod na ni// gnyis tsam sa la sbub par gyis// da rung rim gro byed dgos na// gsum tsam sa la sbub par gyis// shin tu rim gro che dgos na// bzhi tsam sa la sbub par gyis// rim gro che yang 'gyur dka' na// lnga tsam sa la sbub par gyis// drug gam bdun ka sbub pa na// dkon mchog gsum gyi dpang mi byed// dus gsum rgyal bas mnga' mi mdzad// yon bdag snga mar bdud chags rtags// bzang ngan gnyis ni ma nor cig /chang dang chu gnyis ma bsre zhig /trag rak+sha kha mun tra bh+yo/ ru lu ru lu pra me na yo ga /zhes brjod la zhal bu rnams bkrab la/ drug sbub gcig kha yar bstan na yon bdag la ngan/ rnal 'byor pa rang la mi skyon/ gsum mam bzhi sbub na rang dang yon bdag gnyis ka la ngan pas bskang bshags dang bzlog pa chen po byas pas thub// gcig sbub gzhan yar bstan na nyes skyon med/ gzhan gong smos dang mtshungs/ sngags 'di ci mang bzlas na ngan pa thams cad bzlog /rtags bzang na bzla mi dgos/ oṃ na mo ma hā ka pa la sa ma ya/ kra se na ma ra na ha na ha na/ tug tug shīn+taṃ ma hā ka pa na ye swā hā/ de nas zhal bu rnams chus bshal la mdos mdun snod du blug /zhal bu dang gzhi yang bsdu/ yod na tshe gtor dang mda' dar bshams/ mdos gsos la bdud rtsis bran/ bh+yo/ sngon tshe lha dang lha min dmag /ri rab rtse nas 'thab pa'i tshe// lha rnams pham zhing lha gnas zhig /lha min g.yul ngo rgyal ba las// mi pham srid gsum lte ba nas// lha yi dmag dang rdzong bcas te// lha ma yin gyi g.yul ngo bzlog

/lha min dbang pos phyag kyang byas// lha dang mi rnams rmongs pa la// lha mo'i nu mas 'gro drug gsos// lha mo'i thugs kyi gzhal yas nas// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer gyis// phyogs bcu'i bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus nas// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim// bdud rtsi rlangs pa dkar po yis// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams sel// bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mor grags// khyod la dad na ma bas byams// de phyir bdag dang yon bdag gis// lha mo khyod la dad pas mchod// gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// sngon tshe shāka thub spyan snga ru// deng nas 'khor ba ci srid bar// khyed la mchod bstod byed rnams kyi// nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams spel bar byed// de las 'gal na rgyal ba bsdus// rgyal ba'i rdo rjes mgo 'gem shog /de skad khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// dam tshig rjes su dran mdzod la// bcol ba'i las rnams myur 'grub mdzod// bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la// zhal nas bdud rtsi'i char phob la// nad gdon sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// tshe dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// lo thog 'bru yi phung po dang*// rkang 'gros phyugs rnams 'phel bar mdzod// mdor na bdag dang yon bdag gis// mgon dang skyabs su khyod brten gyi// tshe rdzi srog skyobs lha mos mdzod/ kyai/ dbang phyug chen po man chad nas// lag na gzhong thogs yan chad kyi// steng gi lha tshogs thams cad kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi mdzad khro tshul ston// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bla tshe steng gdon ma khyer ram// brgya la gal te khyer ba na// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// nam mkha'i dbyings su ci bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis bsnyab thob cig /steng gdon lag nas mi bla bslus// steng gdon lag nas tshe g.yang skyobs// bum pa 'di la bla tshe g.yung drung skyil/

/bla tshe btsan gyis ma khyer ram// brgya la gal te khyer ba na// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// btsan yul dmar po gar bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis bsnyab thob cig /btsan gyi lag nas mi bla bslus// btsan gyi lag nas tshe g.yang skyobs// bum pa 'di la bla tshe g.yung drung skyil// dmu rje btsan po man chad nas// dmu btsan legs sbyor yan chad kyi// dmu rnams ma lus thams cad kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi mdzad khro tshul ston// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bla tshe dmu yis ma khyer ram// brgya la gal te khyer ba na// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// dmu yul smug por gar bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis bsnyab thob cig /dmu yi lag nas mi bla bslus// dmu yi lag nas tshe g.yang skyobs// bum pa 'di la bla tshe g.yung drung skyil// dga' bo 'jog po man chad nas// ne'u seng skyes pa yan chad kyi// klu rnams ma lus thams cad kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi mdzad khro tshul ston// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bla tshe klu yis ma khyer ram// brgya la gal te khyer ba na// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// klu yul sngon por gar bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis bsnyab thob cig /klu yi lag nas mi bla bslus// klu yi lag nas tshe g.yang skyobs// bum pa 'di la bla tshe g.yung drung skyil// gza' chen brgyad po man chad nas// rgyu skar nyer brgyad yan chad kyi// gza' dang rgyu skar ma lus kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi mdzad khro tshul ston// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi

/bla tshe gza' yis ma khyer ram// brgya la gal te khyer ba na// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// bar snang khams su gar bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis bsnyab thob cig /gza' yi lag nas mi bla bslus// gza' yi lag nas tshe g.yang skyobs// bum pa 'di la bla tshe g.yung drung skyil// gtso mo yum drug man chad nas// 'jig rten dman mo yan chad kyi// mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ma lus kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi mdzad khro tshul ston// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bla tshe mkha' 'gros ma khyer ram// brgya la gal te khyer ba na// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// dur khrod brgyad du gar bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis bsnyab thob cig /mkha' 'gro'i lag nas mi bla bslus// mkha' 'gro'i lag nas tshe g.yang skyobs// bum pa 'di la bla tshe g.yung drung skyil// ma bdud rgyal mo man chad nas// grong rgyu 'dre mo yan chad kyi// ma mo ma lus thams cad kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi mdzad khro tshul ston// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bla tshe ma mos ma khyer ram// brgya la gal te khyer ba na// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// rgya mtsho'i 'gram du gar bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis bsnyab thob cig /ma mo'i lag nas mi bla bslus// ma mo'i lag nas tshe g.yang skyobs// bum pa 'di la bla tshe g.yung drung skyil/ kong btsun de mo man chad nas// 'brog chen 'khor 'dus yan chad kyi// skyong ma ma yams ma lus pas// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi mdzad khro tshul ston// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi

/bla tshe ma yams ma khyer ram// brgya la gal te khyer ba na// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// ri bo'i rtse ru bros gyur kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis bsnyab thob cig /ma yams lag nas mi bla bslus// ma yams lag nas tshe g.yang skyobs// bum pa 'di la bla tshe g.yung drung skyil// srog bdag rgyal po man chad nas// dpe dkar rgyal po yan chad kyi// bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu thams cad kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi mdzad khro tshul ston// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bla tshe bgegs rigs ma khyer ram// brgya la gal te khyer ba na// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// gtsug lag mchod rten gnas sogs gar bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis bsnyab thob cig /bgegs rigs lag nas mi bla bslus// bgegs rigs lag nas tshe g.yang skyobs// bum pa 'di la bla tshe g.yung drung skyil/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas// na raka dmyal ba yan chad kyi// 'gro drug ma lus thams cad kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi mdzad khro tshul ston// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bla tshe rigs drug ma khyer ram// brgya la gal te khyer ba na// mdos dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// rigs drug gnas su gar bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis bsnyab thob cig /rigs drug lag nas mi bla bslus// rigs drug lag nas tshe g.yang skyobs// bum pa 'di la bla tshe g.yung drung skyil// tshe mda' sgro dkar tshe yi rten// tshe dar dmar po tshe yi g.yab// tshe g.yu ljang gu tshe yi zung*// tshe nas dkar mo tshe yi bca'// tshe chang sngon mo tshe yi nyag /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// dpal ldan lha mos tshe gsos srog skyobs shig

/bh+yo ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo// a yu ṣe puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ ci 'grub bzla/ de ltar zhag mang byed na'ang*// zhag gcig dus gsum tshar gsum 'don// nyin rdzogs de nyin phul na yang*// de nyin tshar gsum 'don par bya// 'bul kha gser skyems spyi ltar 'bul// de nas dka' gtor sngon la bzhag /de rgyab ngar mi kha phar bsgyur// de rgyab khrag snod ngar la bzhag /de rgyab mdos nyid zhal bsgyur bzhag /'bru sna gtsang mas rdzongs 'debs su/ bh+yo/ ma cig lha mo dpon g.yog dang*// snang srid ma mo mkha' 'gro dang*// nad bdag dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun// thams cad zhal bsgyur gshegs re ran// nas gro sran ma la sogs pa'i// 'bru sna'i rigs rnams rdzongs su 'debs// rtag tu lo phyugs legs par mdzod// gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs pa'i// rin chen sna tshogs rdzongs su 'debs// bsod nams mnga' thang rgyas par mdzod// dar dang za 'og la sogs pa'i// gos kyi bye brag rdzongs su 'debs// dpal dang gzi brjid rgyas par mdzod// sha khrag gtor ma rdzongs su 'debs// gnod byed dgra bgegs bzlog par mdzod// mar thud phrum la sogs pa yi// dkar gsum zas sna rdzongs su 'debs// dkar phyogs lha ngo rgyas par mdzod// tshwa g.yer sgog pa rdzongs su 'debs// mi kha bra mchu med par mdzod// 'dod yon sna tshogs rdzongs su 'debs// ci 'dod bsam pa lhun grub mdzod// da ni gshegs so gnas su gshegs// dang po lan gcig mi 'byon rgyu// rnal 'byor dam tshig gnyan la dgongs// da ni rang gi gnas su gshegs// ri rab chen po'i rtse la gshegs// yongs 'du'i shing gi rtsa bar gshegs// mu le mthing mtsho'i nang du gshegs// ma pham g.yu mtsho'i nang du gshegs// o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas su gshegs// dur khrod chen po brgyad du gshegs// 'khor gyi lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs// rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs// bh+yo ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo// badz+ra muḥ

sarba bhu ta gats+tsha gats+tsha: ces brjod phyogs ni gtsang ma'am// mkha' 'gro'i gdong dang ma thug par// yas lam lo bdud phyogs su bskyal// phyogs sogs brtsi bar mi shes na// byang shar lha mo'i gnas phyogs su// phul rgyu bskur bas chog pa yin// spros bcas dar nag dang bcas nas// sngags pas bskyal yang rung ba yin// gang ltar gtor gzhong mdun du sbubs/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// bden ldan kun gyi bden stobs kyis// lha mo bsgrub la bar gcod pa'i// lte phur nag mos gtsor byas pa'i// gnod byed dam sri thams cad ni// rim dgu sa yi 'og tu song*// 'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na// gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs// de la rgyu 'bras chos nyon la// byams mgon bstan pa ma byung bar// steng du ldang bar ma byed cig /byams pa mgon po byon pa'i tshe// longs la byang chub sems bskyed zhus// chos skyong srung mas rgyas gdab bo// oṃ lam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ staṃ bha ya nan// de nas bkra shis gang shes brjod// tshe ril rol zhing tshe chang btung*// rjes chog gzhan ni mi dgos so// rims bzlog ma mo'i khrag mdos 'di// nye bar mkho zhing gal che yang*// phyogs 'dir dar srol chung ba yi// phyag len shes mkhan dkon par snang*// rak+sha gter ston gter kha las// khrag mdos rgyas pa byung mod kyang*// ha cang rgyas drag bca' 'don dka'// lug nag bsha' srol yod pa'i phyir// stong rdel ma mo mkhan sogs la// mi la ras pas bka' bskyon che// de phyir de yi bka' srol nub// dgongs gter rtsa tshig rdo rje'i gsung*// rtsa tshig tsam la gzhi byas nas// ma mo 'bum gyi rgyud lung sogs// rgyud sde mang po'i dgongs pa blangs// gsar ma'i lha mo dud sol ma'i// nad bzlog mdos ni stag lung pa// ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa// rang byung rgyal mo'i nad bzlog mdos// gtsug lag phreng bas mdzad pa dang*// rak+sha gter ston gter ma yi// ma mo'i khrag mdos rnying pa dang*// dud sol rang byung re ma ti// lha mo'i rgyud gzhung mang po la// shin tu goms shing 'dris byas te// dpal ldan lha mo dpon g.yog gi

/dbang lung man ngag mtha' yas thob// bsnyen sgrub rtags mtshan thob pa yi// sngags rgan rā ga a s+ya ngas// dus ngan bskal pa snyigs ma la// mi rnams spyod pa ngan pa des// srid pa'i ma mo thams cad 'khrugs// de tshe nad kyi du ru ka /gso rigs gzhung nas ma grags cing*// nad rtags rtsa chu go log ston// sman gyis mi phan dug tu 'gro// mi phyed phyag mas 'debs pa dang*// mi thog yang yang 'bud pa 'byung*// de skad kun mkhyen o rgyan rje'i// gter kha rnams nas lung bstan pa// da ni rim bzhin dus la babs// de dag rnams la phan sems kyis// 'di sogs rkyen bzlog mang du bsgrig /'di dag phan thogs yong mi yong*// dar srol 'gro don 'byung mi 'byung*// brtags phyir ye shes spyan ldan pa'i// yi dam lha la gsol btab pas// phan thogs 'gro don mang po 'ongs// gsungs pa'i rmi lam lung bstan thob// bdag gis rkyen bzlog bsgrigs pa kun// bdag gi shes rab rtsal ma yin// o rgyan rje yi thugs rje yis// byin rlabs gter phran gcig dang mtshungs// phyogs rnams kun tu dar zhing 'phel// khyad par kaḥthog go 'jo'i phyogs// rtsis che ngo mtshar chen por brtsi// de dag 'byung rtags rmi lam du// brda yi rnam pa mang po mthong*// de tshe bdag rang spro ba skyes// de phyir 'di sogs mang du brtsams// 'on kyang chos spyan mi ldan pas// 'gal 'khrul nyes pa'i cha mchis na// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags// dge bas ma 'ongs skye 'gro kun// nad dang gdon las thar gyur nas// mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin par shog /'di nyid 'phel zhing rgyas pa yi// phrin las ma mo kun gyis sgrubs// 'brel tshad bkra shis bde legs shog / 'di yi khyad par man ngag zab mo ni// thal chen yungs dkar ra khrag rus tsheg dang*// sol ba bsres te sngags ni nyer gcig gam// brgya rtsas sngags la rims nad yod pa yi// phyogs su gtor zhing khyim gyi nang rnams gtor// yang na chu la btab nas gtor kyang rung*// de yi lhag ma dur ni mang sar gtor// de yi rims nad gcod pa'i gdams ngag ste// ma mo 'bum gyi rgyud lung chen po yi// le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa nas gsungs// oṃ sa si ru ru pu ru na sa par/
